latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the lap-adhybridhealthservice skill.

- Provides access to the ADHybridHealthService API (2014-01-01) for managing Azure AD Connect Health.
- Supports 77 endpoints for comprehensive Active Directory Domain Service and server health monitoring.
- Requires OAuth2 authentication and an ADHYBRIDHEALTHSERVICE_API_KEY environment variable.
- Enables onboarding, configuration, alert management, and metric queries for AD Domain Services.
